gbm_population_evidence.quote: or glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype): or non-pontine DMG

candidate_evidence.quote: AZD1390 is in a class of medications called kinase inhibitors.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with newly diagnosed primary high-grade glioma (HGG)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: pharmacodynamic markers of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) prior, during and after therapy

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive AZD1390 PO once within 5 days prior to radiation therapy.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: blocking the signals that cause cancer cells to repair deoxyribonucleic acid damage caused by cancer treatments, such as radiation therapy

source_quote.quote: To evaluate the alternative lengthening of telomeres (ALT) phenotype in archival tumor

biomarkers.biomarker_other: homologous recombination deficiency and TP53/DNA repair gene mutations

source_quote.quote: including homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) and associated mutational signatures and TP53/related DNA repair gene mutational status

coder_notes: Paediatric/young adult trial (CHILD, ADULT; up to age 22 in expansion). Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype is one of several named eligible diagnoses alongside HGG, DMG and DIPG. H3 K27-altered and BRAF V600E appear only as diagnosis categories or exclusion, not entry biomarkers. Serum PK only; optional CSF collection is for ctDNA/exploratory use. Exploratory HRD/DNA repair biomarker is linked to the DNA-damage-response inhibitor.
